verdict.rationale: Reclaim's first-party Calendar Sync docs say it creates smart copies of events from a source calendar on a destination calendar. They also say the copies stay up to date as source events change, so nothing needs manual updating, and that availability stays accurate across multiple calendars. External or personal calendars (e.g., iCloud) can be synced into a Google Calendar, which covers keeping work and personal schedules in step. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that copies can be shown as private 'busy' blocks without event details, confirmation of two-way (work↔personal) sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Calendar Sync.
